en: Movement games for kids and adults
zh: 适合儿童和成人的体感游戏

en: Jump over cacti. Squat to cast spells.
zh: 跳过仙人掌，下蹲施放法术。

zh: 蓝色玩家和橙色恐龙跃过明亮的漂浮游乐场。

zh: 每款游戏都会告诉你玩法。

en: For camera games, use a recent version of Chrome or Edge on a computer. Check each game’s illustrated guide for its movement controls and any available demo mode.
zh: 请在电脑上使用较新版本的 Chrome 或 Edge 玩摄像头游戏。查看每款游戏的图示指南，了解体感控制和可用的演示模式。

en: A fun way to fit more movement
zh: 用有趣的方式，让更多运动

en: We’re building games for kids and adults who want to get up and move. Your camera follows your movements, so a squat can power a spell and a jump can clear an obstacle.
zh: 我们为想起身活动的儿童和成人打造游戏。摄像头会跟随你的动作，让一次深蹲为法术蓄力，让一次跳跃越过障碍。

en: Play for a break from homework, between meetings, or whenever you feel like a game. The goal is simple: make physical activity something you look forward to.
zh: 写作业休息时、会议间隙，或任何想玩游戏的时候都可以来一局。目标很简单：让身体活动成为值得期待的事。

en: Choose a game and clear enough room to move comfortably.
zh: 选择一款游戏，清理出足够的空间以便舒适活动。

en: Turn on your camera and follow the setup steps so the game can recognise your movements. Tracking stays on your device.
zh: 打开摄像头并按步骤设置，让游戏能够识别你的动作。跟踪处理始终在你的设备上进行。

en: Follow the game’s instructions and play at your own pace. Your camera turns off when you finish or leave.
zh: 按照游戏提示，以自己的节奏进行。完成或离开时，摄像头会关闭。

en: Play a game. Your replay saves on this device when the round ends. Your clip includes the Hopmodo logo and website, ready to send to friends or download. Open My clips for your sharing options.
zh: 玩一局游戏。本轮结束后，回放会保存在此设备上。片段包含 Hopmodo 标志和网站信息，可发送给朋友或下载。打开“我的片段”查看分享选项。

en: Games record automatically on this device. You choose what to share.
zh: 游戏会自动录制到此设备上，由你决定分享哪些内容。

en: Remove this shared clip? Its link will stop working. Your local video will stay on this device.
zh: 移除这个已分享片段吗？其链接将失效，本地视频仍会保留在此设备上。

en: Manage the videos you published, from any device.
zh: 在任意设备上管理你发布的视频。

en: Account sharing is not available on this site yet. Your local clips are still available.
zh: 此网站暂未开放账户分享功能。本地片段仍可使用。

en: Log in with Integ.Life for private sharing and to manage your account videos.
zh: 登录 Integ.Life，即可私密分享并管理账户中的视频。

en: 2 GB of shared storage per account. Logging in does not upload your local videos.
zh: 每个账户有 2 GB 分享存储空间。登录不会上传你的本地视频。

en: Deleting clips frees space. Shared clips expire after 7 days. Each clip can be up to 90 seconds / 20 MiB.
zh: 删除片段可以释放空间。分享的片段会在 7 天后过期。每个片段最长 90 秒、最大 20 MiB。

en: Choose a video from My local clips to publish it here.
zh: 从“我的本地片段”中选择一个视频发布到这里。

en: Your game and camera view record automatically during gameplay, with game sound when available. Only the latest two videos stay on this device; replays keep the latest 90 seconds at normal speed. Conversation recording is optional. Anonymous play counts and active time are sent to this site. Video is uploaded only when you choose to share.
zh: 游戏过程中会自动录下游戏和摄像头画面，并包含可用的游戏声音。此设备只保留最新两个视频；回放以正常速度保留最近 90 秒。对话录音由你选择开启。匿名游玩次数和有效时长会发送到本站。只有主动分享时才会上传视频。

en: Your game records automatically when you start. Only your two latest videos stay on this device. Replays keep the latest 90 seconds at normal speed.
zh: 游戏开始后会自动录制。此设备只保留最新两个视频。回放以正常速度保留最近 90 秒。

en: Place your camera so your shoulders, hips and hands stay in view. Enable the camera, stand still with both hands down, and complete calibration. Raise both hands above your shoulders for one second, then lower them to start.
zh: 调整摄像头，让肩膀、髋部和双手保持在画面中。开启摄像头，双手放下并站稳，完成校准。将双手举过肩膀并保持一秒，再放下双手开始。

en: Hold both hands above your shoulders for one second to pause or resume. Lower your hands between commands. Tracking loss pauses the game; return to view and choose Resume.
zh: 将双手举过肩膀并保持一秒，即可暂停或继续。每次指令之间请放下双手。跟踪丢失时游戏会暂停；回到画面中并选择“继续”。

en: Raise your left wrist above your left shoulder, then lower it below your shoulder before the next action. Holding it up triggers only once.
zh: 将左手腕举过左肩；下一次动作前，再降到肩膀下方。持续举手只会触发一次。

en: Complete five squat-and-stand actions to defeat the forest guardian.
zh: 完成五次下蹲再站起的动作，击败森林守卫。

en: Enable the camera, keep shoulders through ankles visible, turn slightly sideways and stand upright for about two seconds to calibrate.
zh: 开启摄像头，让肩膀到脚踝保持可见，身体稍微侧转并站直约两秒来完成校准。

en: Guide the helicopter through the openings between gates.
zh: 引导直升机穿过障碍之间的开口。

en: Enable the camera and stand still to calibrate. Raise your LEFT hand above your shoulder for one second with your right hand down. Then follow the three-second countdown.
zh: 开启摄像头并站稳完成校准。右手放下，将左手举过肩膀并保持一秒。然后跟随三秒倒计时。

en: This is a button-controlled concept, not a camera AR game.
zh: 这是按钮控制的概念版本，并非摄像头 AR 游戏。

en: When ready, raise both hands above your shoulders for one second, then lower them to start.
zh: 准备好后，将双手举过肩膀并保持一秒，再放下双手开始。

en: Astra in Codex helps us design, code, and test.
zh: Codex 中的 Astra 帮助我们设计、编程和测试。

en: From an idea to a working page.
zh: 从一个想法到可用的页面。

en: We used Astra with the Impeccable design skill to try layouts, write the interface, and bring our games into one arcade. A separate agent generated the playground artwork while work on the page continued.
zh: 我们使用 Astra 和 Impeccable 设计技能尝试布局、编写界面，并把各款游戏汇集到同一个游戏大厅。页面开发继续进行的同时，另一个智能体生成了游乐场插图。

en: How a movement becomes a game action.
zh: 身体动作如何变成游戏操作。

en: MediaPipe estimates body positions using your camera, on your device. Each game turns those positions into controls: completed squats in Motion Quest and changes in jump height in Dino Run.
zh: MediaPipe 使用摄像头在你的设备上估算身体位置。每款游戏再把这些位置转成控制：Motion Quest 使用完成的深蹲，Dino Run 使用跳跃高度的变化。

en: Build it, try it, improve it.

Astra reads the code, makes changes, and runs automated checks. We can give feedback during a task, such as making the page bolder or making a game easier to find. We still need people to try the movement controls and tell us what works.
zh: Astra 会阅读代码、进行修改并运行自动检查。我们可以在任务过程中提供反馈，例如让页面更醒目，或让游戏更容易找到。我们仍需要真人试玩体感控制，并告诉我们哪些设计有效。

en: A closer look at the build

The build used parallel agent tasks for artwork, browser checks for the play and recording flows, and a separate design review. These checks help catch software and layout problems; they don’t tell us how accurately the camera recognises every player.
zh: 构建过程使用了并行智能体任务来制作插图，用浏览器检查游戏与录制流程，并进行了单独的设计审查。这些检查有助于发现软件和布局问题，但不能说明摄像头识别每位玩家的准确程度。

en: Games share a common format for body positions and completed actions. That keeps tracking separate from game rules and helps prevent one movement from scoring twice. The arcade adds game selection and automatic on-device replays. When gallery sharing is enabled, published clips are stored in Google Cloud Storage.
zh: 各款游戏对身体位置和已完成动作使用共同格式。这让动作跟踪与游戏规则保持分离，也有助于避免同一个动作重复计分。游戏大厅提供游戏选择和设备端自动回放。启用作品展廊分享后，发布的片段会存储在 Google Cloud Storage。

en: The games encourage movement; they don’t assess exercise technique or measure calories. Concept previews are labeled because their camera controls aren’t built yet.
zh: 这些游戏鼓励身体活动，但不会评估运动姿势或测量卡路里。概念预览会明确标注，因为其摄像头控制尚未完成。
